params.batchId: : used to track the progress of SNARK proofs.
params.instances: : list of public instances to verify along with SNARK proof.     Encoding of instances must be consistent with circuit:     - 12 * aggregation circuit lhs & rhs values used by verifier     - state before:         - l1 to l2 message queue hash before         - l2 to l1 message queue hash before         - eternal mpt root before         - ephemeral mpt root before     - state after:         - l1 to l2 message queue hash after         - l2 to l1 message queue hash after         - eternal mpt root after         - ephemeral mpt root after
params.l1ToL2MessageCnt: : number of l1 to m2 message to be consumed in SNARK proof. This is used as an auxiliary     variable to help proof verification and on-chain state update, while not impacting proof soundness.
params.l2ToL1Messages: : preimages of l2 to l1 message. This is used as an auxiliary variable to help proof     verification and on-chain state update, while not impacting proof soundness.
params.lastEventId: : used to track the progress of SNARK proofs.

constructor.details: Vault contract must be deployed with upgradeable proxy. Initialization from constructor is disabled.

adminAddress().notice: Returns the address of the current admin.

checkAndRegisterUser(bytes,address,uint8.notice: Check whether <vesselKey, address> mapping is signed by operator.     If signature is valid, register user and add to L1->L2 message queue.

commitSnarkProof(uint256[],bytes,uint256.notice: Only operator can commit SNARK proof to update on-chain state.

constrainAmountWithPrecision(uint256,uin.notice: constrain amount to align with asset precisionDigit and decimals.     The returned constrainedAmount is truncated to be multiple of (0.1 ** precisionDigit)      and then multiply to (10 ** decimals).

fastWithdraw(address,address,address,uin.notice: Withdraw asset in an expeditious manner.     Only whitelisted exitLP can call this function.     Assets will be transfered from exitLP and not affect assets under the Vault.     Message queue will be updated to notify off-chain processor to refill the exitLP.

getL1ToL2MessageQueueCommitIndex().notice: returns last committed message hash and index of l1->l2 message queue.

getL1ToL2MessageQueueHashAt(uint256).notice: returns raw message by given index of l1->l2 message queue.

getL1ToL2MessageQueueTailIndex().notice: returns tail message hash and index of l1->l2 message queue.

getL2ToL1MessageQueueCommitHash().notice: returns last committed message hash of l2->l1 message queue.

isExitManager(address).notice: Returns if an account is an exit manager.

isOperator(address).notice: Returns if an account is an operator.

registerExitManager(address).notice: Register a new exit liquidity provider for fast withdraw.

registerNewAsset(address,uint256,uint8,u.notice: Only operator can register a new asset.

registerUser(bytes,address,uint8,bytes32.notice: Check and register a user.     User registration is authorized by operator signature to avoid potential exploit like transaction front-run.

setAssetActive(uint256).notice: Only operator can activate an asset.

setAssetInactive(uint256).notice: Only operator can activate an asset.

transferAdmin(address).notice: Transfers admin role of the contract to a new account (`newAdmin`).

unregisterExitManager(address).notice: Unregister a new exit liquidity provider.

updateAssetLimitAndPrecision(uint256,uin.notice: Only operator can update limitDigit and precisionDigit. Asset address and decimals cannot be changed.

updateCircuitVersion(string).notice: Only admin can update circuit version.
